title: Android Telecalling Suite Development
desc:
I need an end-to-end telecalling solution made up of an Android app for my callers and a web dashboard for supervisors. The app must handle every step of a call session—dialing, recording the conversation, and instantly linking the recording to the right customer profile. While the caller works, customer information should be visible and editable in real time, and any updates must sync immediately with the web panel.

Key functions I expect from day one are call recording, integrated customer-information management, and real-time analytics that show live call status and daily performance numbers. On top of that, I also want automated call scheduling so tomorrow’s call list is ready without manual effort, in-app messaging so supervisors can coach callers without switching tools, and performance tracking that rolls up talk time, conversion rate, and other KPIs into clear, drill-down reports. I will likely add more capabilities as we refine the workflow, so the architecture should be modular and easy to extend.

To keep the hand-off smooth, please provide:

• Android source code and a signed release APK  
• A browser-based admin panel with user-role management  
• REST or GraphQL APIs documented in Swagger/OpenAPI  
• A one-click deployment script (Docker or similar) for server components  
• Basic user documentation so new callers can be onboarded in minutes  

I’m comfortable discussing tech stacks—Kotlin, Java, Flutter, React, Node, Laravel, or whichever combination you’re mo

title: Financial Data Entry & Organization
desc:
I have several Excel spreadsheets containing raw financial figures that now need to be brought together into a single, well-structured workbook. The focus of this project is strictly data entry and organization: transferring each numeric record accurately, arranging it under clear headings, applying uniform date and currency formats, and setting up basic cross-sheet links so every total rolls up correctly.

Everything is already digital—no PDFs or paper scans involved—so you can work directly from the original Excel files I will share via cloud folder. Consistency is critical; I want to be able to sort, filter, or run quick pivots without hitting hidden blanks, merged cells, or naming inconsistencies.

Deliverables:
• One consolidated Excel workbook with all financial data entered and logically grouped  
• Standardized column titles, data types, and number/date formats across every sheet  
• A brief hand-off note summarizing sheet structure, any assumptions made, and a quick check list I can follow for spot-verification

If you normally use Excel shortcuts, Power Query, or even a light VBA script to speed repetitive entry, feel free—just keep the final file macro-free unless we discuss otherwise. Accuracy matters more than speed, so build in as many double-checks as you like before sending the finished workbook back to me.

title: Technical AI Response Evaluator
desc:
I need every batch of ChatGPT-style answers on technical topics combed through for factual accuracy and for how clearly and appropriately the ideas are expressed. For each response you will pinpoint any incorrect or incomplete statements, note ambiguities in wording or tone, and explain why they matter. Depth is key—I want a detailed error analysis rather than a high-level score.

The work will follow my internal rubric, but you are welcome to help refine that rubric as patterns emerge. Typical workflow:

• Receive a spreadsheet or JSON dump of model outputs  
• Review against trusted technical sources or documentation  
• Record each error with a brief correction, severity flag, and comment on tone/clarity  
• Return a scored sheet plus a short summary of recurring issues for the engineering team

Acceptance criteria  
• Every answer tagged with at least one of: correct, partially correct, incorrect  
• All identified errors linked to a source or rationale  
• Summary highlights at least three widespread problems per batch and suggests fixes

Turnaround on the first test set is flexible but ideally within 48 hours once materials arrive. Reliable communication and independent work are essential because the role is fully remote. If this scope matches your skill set, I’m ready to share the first dataset and guidelines right away.

title: Intraday Nifty Trend Algo
desc:
I need a complete, ready-to-deploy algorithm that trades Nifty and Bank Nifty on an intraday basis using a pure trend-following logic. The core of the job is to translate the strategy into clean, well-commented code, run solid back-tests, and hand over something I can plug straight into my trading setup.

Here’s what I expect:  
• Source code that implements the full entry, exit, and risk-management rules for a trend-following approach.  
• A concise back-test report showing performance over a representative historical sample.  
• Clear setup instructions so I can run the strategy on my end (whether you write it in Python, Pine Script, or another suitable language).

Acceptance will be based on the code executing without errors, signals aligning with the documented logic, and the back-test reproducing your stated metrics on my machine.

title: Remote Work Focus Habits (Chinese)
desc:
I’m looking for a native Chinese writer to help adapt short content about simple focus habits people use while working from home.
The content should feel practical and relatable — small daily habits that help people stay focused during remote work, such as setting a clear start time, limiting distractions, taking short breaks, or creating a simple work setup. Keep the tone natural and easy to read, not technical or overly formal.
Some of the source text is in English and needs to be rewritten into clear, natural Chinese.
Sample Task (please include in your proposal)
Adapt this short English text into natural Chinese:
Original:
Many people working from home develop small habits to stay focused. Some set a clear start time, keep their phone in another room, or take short breaks after finishing a task. These simple routines often make it easier to stay productive throughout the day.
What I need from you

Native Simplified Chinese speaker
Ability to write natural, easy-to-read Chinese
Keep the tone practical and relatable

Deliverables

Clean Chinese versions of the content
Natural flow and clear wording
Consistent and simple style


Send your Chinese version of the sample text above and confirm you are a native Simplified Chinese speaker.

If you cannot bid on this project due to the $20 fee, please apply using the PDF/docs attached to this project.

2. A clear three-act structure with a satisfying yet grounded resolution.

• Tài liệu hướng dẫn cài đặt môi trường, biên dịch và triển khai server trên Windows.

• Kết nối ổn định, đồng bộ hoá dữ liệu nhân vật theo thời gian thực.  
• Cấu trúc module hoá: Login, Game World, Chat, Event, Item Shop tách riêng.  
• Có thể thêm bản đồ, class hoặc sự kiện mới mà không phải viết lại lõi server.

Vui lòng gửi kèm:

title: Aluminum System Structural Validation
desc:
I need a thorough structural calculation and performance check on a newly designed aluminum profile system, with special focus on the largest 3 m × 3 m configuration before cascading the findings to the smaller variants. The study must cover both static and dynamic load analysis so that I can confirm each profile, connection detail, reinforcement option, and fixing method is truly fit for purpose.

Material fatigue is my prime concern, so the calculation package has to explore long-term cyclic effects alongside the usual strength and stiffness checks. If you spot joint failure or deformation risks during the process, flag them, but the fatigue life is the critical pass/fail criterion.

Please ground every assumption in recognised codes and clearly document the input data, equations, safety factors, and results. Finite-element modelling, hand verification sheets, and concise summary tables are all welcome as long as they tell a coherent story. 

Deliverables:
• Full calculation report (PDF) with static & dynamic analyses, fatigue assessment, and code references  
• Editable analysis files (e.g., FEA model, spreadsheets)  
• A short design-change memo if any modifications are needed to meet the target capacities  

When you reply, highlight relevant experience with aluminium structures and any similar projects you have taken from concept to verification.

title: Freelance Retail Finance Manager Needed
desc:
I’m looking for a seasoned Finance & Accounting professional who can step in right away on a part-time, freelance basis and keep our retail books in top shape. The immediate focus is threefold: deliver clear, timely financial reports, build rolling budgets and sales-driven forecasts, and prepare our tax filings so nothing slips through the cracks.

Because we sell direct to consumers, you’ll be working with inventory-heavy data and daily sales feeds. I already have cloud bookkeeping in place (QuickBooks Online and Excel are our day-to-day tools), so you should feel comfortable jumping straight into those files and tightening the month-end close without a long learning curve.

Key deliverables  
• Monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements ready for management review  
• A 12-month budget with scenario-based forecasts that can be updated each quarter  
• Complete federal and state tax prep with supporting schedules, ready for my signature  

The turnaround is ASAP, so I’ll give you immediate access to the current books and sales reports the moment we agree to work together. If you have availability to start this week and can commit to a few focused hours each month, let’s connect and get things moving.

title: Detail Tejas & Rafale 3D Model Creation
desc:
Please noted that -  700USD fix price are both jet

I will supply high-resolution reference photos, sectional drawings, and verified dimensions for the HAL Tejas and Dassault Rafale. Your task is to translate that data into two separate, highly accurate 3D files that a tooling shop can drop straight into mold machining or a printer can slice without cleanup.

Focus areas  
The cockpit, engine assemblies, and landing gear must carry the finest level of surface and component detail; every panel line, actuator, and intake contour needs to read cleanly at scale. Secondary surfaces such as wings and fuselage still have to meet aero-profile tolerances but can be kept to a more uniform topology as long as they remain watertight.

Technical expectations  
• Output format: single, watertight STL per aircraft  
• Geometry: non-manifold free, evenly distributed quads/tris, zero overlapping faces  
• Wall thickness: manufacturing-ready (I will confirm target scale once the base mesh is approved)  
• Naming & hierarchy: clear part naming so molds can be split logically  
• Revision allowance: up to three feedback cycles included in the fixed fee  
• Deadline: ASAP—please indicate the quickest realistic turnaround you can commit to

Acceptance will be based on:  
1. Dimensional accuracy against the supplied blueprints (±0.2 mm at 1:48 scale)  
2. Successful import into SolidWorks and a slicing test in Cura without error flags  
3. Visual approval of cockpit, engine, and landing gear fideli

Ruang lingkup pekerjaan:

Harap gunakan software desain profesional seperti Adobe Illustrator atau InDesign, dan pastikan format akhir dalam AI, PDF, serta PNG beresolusi tinggi. Saya terbuka untuk satu hingga dua revisi ringan guna menyempurnakan detail kecil sebelum produksi.
